# Isaiah Chapter 41 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 29 verses]*

*Cyrus from the east; Israel as servant chosen; idol-makers mocked; God holds your right hand*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 41 (Fear Not) addresses cyrus from the east; israel as servant chosen; idol-makers mocked; god holds your right hand. The key verse — "Fear not, for I am with you; be not dismayed, for I am your God" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to Second Isaiah (chs. 40-55), focused on comfort, restoration, and the servant figure.
